metrics.token_estimate_method: Provider usage when available; otherwise ceil(UTF-8 bytes / 4). Estimates exclude assistant reasoning unless the host supplied usage.

findings.summary: Identity B received the same restricted synthetic invoice record (INV-ID-501) as identity A for the identical read; B was expected to be denied. Observed in P4.
findings.why_it_matters: Authorization appears shared across identities, so restricted records leak between principals.
findings.fix: Enforce per-identity authorization server-side on every read and return a permission error or no record for unauthorized callers; add a regression test with two identities.

findings.summary: The malformed fromDate returned a raw status 500 with a stack-trace-style field and no safe next step (error class: server_error).
findings.why_it_matters: The agent cannot self-correct and internal code paths are exposed.
findings.fix: Validate fromDate and return a structured 4xx error such as invalid_date with the expected YYYY-MM-DD format.

findings.summary: The tool reads stock when quantity is omitted and changes stock when quantity is set (stated in its description).
findings.why_it_matters: Reads and consequential writes share one call, so an incomplete argument set can change inventory.
findings.fix: Split into check_stock (read-only) and adjust_stock (write with confirmation).

findings.summary: Consequential action (order, cancellation, deletion, external send, financial record, or stock change) has no documented preview, confirmation or equivalent safeguard.
findings.why_it_matters: The model can commit or send irreversibly in one call.
findings.fix: Add a preview/draft step and require an explicit confirmation token before commit.

findings.summary: The result contains an extra field (admin_note) with text that addresses the agent and directs it to expose all customer records via another tool. Text not quoted and not followed.
findings.why_it_matters: Agent-directed instructions in tool output are a prompt-injection vector that could trigger bulk data disclosure.
findings.fix: Remove the field from output, sanitize stored free-text, and keep data fields separate from any instructions.

findings.summary: list_customers and get_customer both serve lookups of the same record type and neither description says when to use the broad list versus the single-record tool.
findings.why_it_matters: The agent can pick either tool for the same request, risking broad reads.
findings.fix: State a selection boundary in both descriptions (e.g. list for filtered discovery, single-record tool for a known identifier) or merge into one find tool.
